elements.label: Order No. 227
elements.description:
'Not a step back!'
[This can prevent soldiers from fleeing.]

elements.label: Make an example.
elements.description:
I executed a deserter in public without a word. Before his blood splashed on my boots, discipline was restored.
[This can prevent soldiers from fleeing.]

elements.label: Military Orders Are as Unshakable as a Mountain
elements.description:
The power of steel and snow is revealed through my words; I have become their greatest fear.
[This can prevent soldiers from fleeing.]

elements.label: Breakthrough successful!
elements.description: The enemy's encirclement was torn apart at the last moment; the cage of fire and wire finally showed cracks. [While this card is present, your troops can march to the next war zone; when the card disappears, it will not absorb the remaining friendly troops in the encirclement. You can refresh the cooldown by using 'Breakout Route' in 'Action'.]
elements.comments: 此卡用来表明可以撤离了

elements.label: Besieged!
elements.description: Supplies are cut off, no way out. The city's borders have become the front line. We are nailed to this fortress of ruins.
elements.comments: 此卡用来表明当地被包围

elements.label: Main Objective: Breakout
elements.description:
Holding out for reinforcements is a luxury; only attack can break out. We must advance—no matter how much blood is shed.
[You cannot leave this war zone until this objective is completed.]

elements.label: Breakout Route?
elements.description: Fate has not completely sealed off the way out; we still have a chance... [You can combine five 'Breakout Route' cards to regain 'Main Objective: Breakout'.]
